summary: First-across-the-line hardware security challenge: use side-channel analysis (power, EM or timing) on the RP2350 self-decrypting AES boot to leak enough key material to decrypt the payload.
eligibility: Not verified. Needs hardware security equipment. Fault injection and optical attacks are out of scope.
title: RP2350 Hacking Challenge 2

prize.description: US$20,000 to a single winner or winning team (organizers say the pool may change).
